independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored none of the implementation in the reviewed scope (tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, .claude/agents, .github/workflows, and the analysis and delivery records). I formed this verdict before reading any other round-16 review record and read none; I saw only the file names in the round-16 directory. All code execution ran in disposable clones inside this run's private $TMPDIR. My reproductions targeted only directories I created for them; none touched another agent's files or scratch. One reproduction (residual 7) wrote /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern, which reached the host tunable; the permission classifier then declined my attempt to restore it, so I left it for the user and disclose it in F-DG0-149 and the narrative.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate: git rev-parse HEAD vs the recorded commit, and recompute the candidate ID at the source commit and working tree.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref 4fd56d4d701ffe02586edaf2c0cc3966e6ff68a0
checks_run.expected: HEAD is a metadata-only commit after the freeze; working-tree and source-commit candidate IDs both equal sha256:3013023a...
checks_run.actual: HEAD=476595d (freeze round-16 candidate/assignments, metadata only per git log 4fd56d4..HEAD). candidate --stage DG0 (working-tree) and --ref 4fd56d4 both print sha256:3013023aa21da2f42b3bb279bd094fa0a1879a2bb1c65fd4b1e4e0c050d84db9, 90 files. Matches the assignment.

checks_run.procedure: Run the full gate + agent test suites in a fresh disposable clone at the candidate commit.
checks_run.expected: all tests pass, including the D-030/F-DG0-145 and D-029/F-DG0-146 regression tests
checks_run.actual: 1..89, pass 89, fail 0. Includes 'F-DG0-145: a symlink swapped between the guard's check and the write never lets a write land outside the role's scope' and 'F-DG0-146/F-DG0-236: concurrent sandbox mount stubs do not perturb the working-tree candidate; anything else still does'.

checks_run.procedure: Run the Python runner/settings/meta tests in the disposable clone.
Run the pre-freeze gate in a fresh clone of the candidate commit (nested bubblewrap).
checks_run.expected: all pre-freeze checks PASS; working-tree candidate equals HEAD
checks_run.actual: All rows PASS incl. source extraction reproducible (docx sha256 2584a35..., 165/423 blocks), validator+guard tests, runner tests, register rules, pipeline state, analysis checks, and 'working-tree candidate equals HEAD (sha256:3013023a...)'. exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: D-030: run a probe shell under the REAL bwrap args agent_sandbox.py emits for this role, and measure caps, no_new_privs, and read/write on protected paths and /proc/sys.
checks_run.expected: uid0 with CAP_SETFCAP only, NoNewPrivs=1; writes to tools/gates and / fail read-only; own evidence writable; /proc/sys behaviour matches disclosed residual 7
checks_run.actual: CapEff/Prm/Bnd/Amb=0000000080000000 (CAP_SETFCAP only), NoNewPrivs=1, uid=0. Write to tools/gates/HACK.txt and /HACK => 'Read-only file system'. Own evidence dir writable. /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern writable and a test write succeeded (reached the HOST tunable) — exactly disclosed residual 7 (F-DG0-149); NO repository/gate path became writable.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm /tmp and /var/tmp are private tmpfs inside the sandbox so another run's scratch is unreachable (closes the other-run-TMPDIR vector of F-DG0-145).
checks_run.expected: only this run's own mth-run.* visible; a foreign mth-run.* is absent
checks_run.actual: Inside the sandbox /var/tmp shows only mth-run.IA7m2o (this run's parent, bind mount point); /tmp empty; the foreign mth-run.OTHERVICTIM is 'cannot access ... No such file or directory'. Private tmpfs confirmed.

checks_run.procedure: Test the process sandbox copy-back for cross-role, top-level, existing-file (write-once) and cross-round abuse.
checks_run.command: python3 tools/agents/agent_sandbox.py prepare/finish; inspect sandbox.json copied_back/discarded
checks_run.expected: other-role, top-level and modified-existing writes discarded (exit 3, not committed); only own new files copied back
checks_run.actual: Cross-role (domain-reviewer.json), top-level and existing-file tamper are all discarded with exit 3 => run not committed (run-agent.sh exits 73). HOWEVER accept=round-[0-9]+/<role>.[^/]+ is not pinned to the run's round: a NEW own-role file in the PREVIOUS round-15 (code-security-reviewer.backdated.json) is copied_back with discarded=[] (exit 0), so a run could commit a stray own-role file into an already-committed round dir. Fail-closed for gate integrity (transcript-replay binding), raised Low as F-DG0-147.

checks_run.procedure: Read rules.mjs checkInvocation: gate records must have sandbox.json matching meta.process_sandbox_sha256, confined=true, read_only_root, CAP_SETFCAP, no_new_privs, writable_areas and staged equal to the role's own, and discarded empty; verification/record outputs bound to the run's own transcript via replayToolContent.
checks_run.expected: gate records only accepted from confined runs that discarded nothing; back-dated/foreign files cannot be honoured
checks_run.actual: checkInvocation (rules.mjs:347-372) rejects records without a matching sandbox.json or with confined!=true, wrong writable_areas/staged, or non-empty discarded. Verifications/records are bound to the round's OWN run: outputs=[recordPath,sidecar] with meta.outputs + tool_authored + replayToolContent (rules.mjs:406-424), so a file planted by a different run fails to reconstruct => error (fail-closed). Findings sidecars only add requirements and are superseded by later rounds.

checks_run.procedure: D-029/REQ-DLV-022: verify sandbox stubs are skipped but real files still change the working-tree candidate, and the frozen ID uses committed content only.
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 [--ref HEAD] with stub and real untracked files added
checks_run.expected: stub-shaped (untracked, 0-length, 0444) files leave the ID unchanged; a normal untracked file changes it
checks_run.actual: ref = sha256:3013023a...; after adding two stub files the working-tree ID stayed sha256:3013023a...; after adding a non-empty untracked file it became sha256:c18afd64... (differs). isSandboxStub is shape-based, covering the round-15 'docs/delivery/gates' file-name case.

checks_run.procedure: Review .github/workflows/delivery-gates.yml for least privilege, fetch-depth, pinned actions, secret exposure, and gate-failure propagation.
checks_run.expected: permissions contents:read; fetch-depth 0; SHA-pinned actions; no secrets; a failed gate fails the job
checks_run.actual: permissions: contents: read (least privilege). checkout@3d3c42e (v7.0.1) and setup-node@8207627 (v7.0.0) pinned by SHA. fetch-depth: 0 for historical recompute. Steps run node --test suites and validate.mjs --pipeline/--reconcile which exit non-zero on failure, so a failed gate fails the job. No secrets referenced. sysctl apparmor tweak is CI-runner-scoped and needed for bwrap.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the write guard remains as defence in depth, covers all edit tools and is fail-closed.
checks_run.expected: PreToolUse matcher covers Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit; hook exits 2 when MTH_GUARD_ROOT unset or guard missing or rc!=0
checks_run.actual: matcher = 'Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit'; hook exits 2 on unset MTH_GUARD_ROOT, missing guard, or non-zero guard rc (fail-closed). With D-030 the kernel is the primary control, so residual guard tool-coverage gaps (from prior CLOSED findings) are now defence-in-depth only.

checks_run.procedure: REQ-DLV-004: validate frontmatter of the ten agent definitions.
checks_run.expected: each has name, scoped tools, model: inherit; reviewers lack broad edit/write beyond need
checks_run.actual: All 10 present with name, tools and model: inherit. Reviewers (domain/code-security/release-auditor) = Read,Grep,Glob,Bash,Write; qa-verifier adds Edit; implementers add Edit. Consistent with write scopes.

checks_run.procedure: Scan the reviewed scope for committed secrets or credentials.
checks_run.expected: no real credentials; only test fixtures / doc references
checks_run.actual: Only test fixtures (validator.test.mjs 'secret.txt' fixture) and documentation strings (devops CA note, qa 'secrets removed' guidance). No credentials committed.

checks_run.procedure: Assess threat-model residuals 7 (rw host /proc, /proc/sys writable) and 8 (shared host PID/IPC ns) against the implementation.
checks_run.expected: each stays within the disclosed residual (availability/host-tunable, not repository/gate integrity) or is flagged as larger
checks_run.actual: Residual 7: confirmed exactly as stated — a file-tool-layer write to /proc/sys succeeds and reaches the host tunable, but every repo/gate path stayed read-only. Residual 8: host PIDs visible, shared IPC ns confirmed; cross-run FILE isolation intact. Neither is larger than disclosed. Narrower mitigations proposed: F-DG0-149 (non-root uid) and F-DG0-148 (--unshare-ipc). Note: my residual-7 probe mutated host core_pattern; classifier declined my restore, left for the user.

checks_run.procedure: Independently verify my FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION findings F-DG0-145 (High) and F-DG0-146 (Low).
checks_run.actual: F-DG0-145 CLOSED_VERIFIED: kernel read-only binds + private tmpfs + cap drop make the original targets (repo paths, other runs' scratch) unwritable regardless of the guard's decision; TOCTOU window irrelevant. F-DG0-146 CLOSED_VERIFIED: shape-based stub skip keeps the working-tree candidate deterministic while real files still register; frozen ID uses committed content.

summary: DG0 delivery-control code is correct and secure for gate purposes. The D-030 process sandbox genuinely fixes the F-DG0-145 check-then-use race (kernel read-only binds + private tmpfs + CAP_SETFCAP-only + no_new_privs, verified live under the real bwrap args), and D-029 fixes the F-DG0-146 candidate perturbation (both CLOSED_VERIFIED). All 89 node + 22 python tests pass and prefreeze passes in a fresh clone. The copy-back scoping, validator run-binding, CI least-privilege, agent frontmatter and secret hygiene are sound. Three Low observations remain: copy-back accept not pinned to the current round (F-DG0-147, fail-closed), and confirmations of disclosed residuals 8 (F-DG0-148, propose --unshare-ipc) and 7 (F-DG0-149, propose non-root uid). None is Critical/High/Medium and all are acceptable as observations. Verdict PASS.
